what_works: Hero section uses a large background image with bold white headline and a semi‑transparent pink CTA box, establishing clear visual hierarchy.
Navigation bar is fixed, uses ample white space, and separates primary links from utility icons with simple icons and text.
Story cards maintain uniform dimensions, consistent image cropping, and a clear typographic hierarchy (date, read time, title, button) with generous padding.
Accent color (pink) is applied sparingly to CTA elements, adding visual interest while preserving the overall clean aesthetic.
